title: Scattering on the cube corner
plain: Defocusing cubic Schrödinger in the plane scatters for all finite-mass data. Show the same on the surface of an infinite cube corner.
math: Let $\mathcal C$ be the flat cone of angle $3\pi/2$ (boundary of an octant). Prove that every $u_0\in L^2(\mathcal C)$ gives a global solution of $iu_t+\Delta u=|u|^2u$ that scatters in $L^2$ as $t\to\pm\infty$.
